items.statement: Generated INR192 crores operating cash flow in H1 FY27; inventory fell from INR528 crores to INR206 crores and trade receivables from INR406 crores to INR367 crores.
items.quote: During H1 FY27, the company generated approximately INR192 crores of cash flow from operating activities. This is a positive indicator of underlying operating expense of the business.

items.statement: Expect INR25-30 crores CBG capital subsidy by December or January (25% of INR120 crores eligible).
items.quote: So, for the quarter or even say their math of a timeline for the next quarter, first or second month by, sir, we are definitely expecting a INR25 crores to INR30 crores i.e., 25% of INR120 crores means, you can work out to close to INR30 crores of subsidy we are expecting by December or January.

items.statement: No fresh equity issuance planned; Badami plant sale proceeds (INR171 crores) to repay INR125 crores term debt and fund working capital.
items.quote: So of that INR170 crores, Anand sir can elaborate. There is a current outstanding of about INR130-odd crores of debt there so that INR130 crores of debt will be repaid using INR171 crores of the capital that we would receive.

items.statement: Promoters Ashish Agarwal and Dev Agarwal will not draw salaries from Q3 FY27 for at least 10 quarters to support profitability and growth.
items.quote: Another important key note which the management wish es to convey to all the investors is that from 1st October onwards, both the promoters and executive directors, Ashish Agarwal and Dev Agarwal, plan to not draw any sal aries from the

items.statement: GST input credit refunds will become liquid cash from November 2025 with monthly refunds on filed GST returns
items.quote: From 1st November onwards, that would be a kind of a liquid cash for us. We should be able to get refunds month-on-month on those, every month filed GST.

items.statement: Net operating cash flow surplus for H1 FY27 grew 27% year-on-year to INR3.5 billion, representing 63% of FY26 full-year surplus and 45% of collections, up from 40% a year ago.
items.quote: On cash flows, our net operating cash flow surplus for H1 grew 27% year-on-year to INR3.5 billion, which is 63% of FY '26 record full year surplus, and 45% of collections, up from 40% a year ago.

items.statement: Working capital saw an outflow of INR14.7 crores in H1 FY27 versus positive INR13.8 crores last year due to higher inventory costs and debtor base from inflation
items.quote: working capital saw an outflow of around INR14.7 crores in H1 FY27 compared to a positive contribution of INR13.8 crores last year

items.statement: Cash and bank balance including HQLA is close to INR 600 crores as of Q2 FY27
items.quote: As of now, we are having close to the INR600 crores plus, including the HQLA requirement.

items.statement: Board approved a proposed preferential issue of approximately INR312 crores to fund acquisitions and general corporate purposes.
items.quote: On 16th October 2026, the Board approved a proposed preferentia l issue of approximately INR312 crores

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of INR 17.6 crores as of 30th September 2026
items.quote: On cash and balance sheet, we continue to remain a debt -free balance sheet, maintain a debt -free balance sheet with a cash and bank balance of INR 17.6 crores as of 30th September 2026.

items.statement: Director Mitesh Bohra availed an interest-bearing loan of up to $1 million under company policy and repaid it within 3-4 months.
items.quote: since Mitesh is also a director and an employee of InfoBeans INC, so, he availed that facility and it was a, I would say, 3-4 month period between which it was repaid as well. So there was an interest bearing loan that was given to him and under all the norms that we have followed that is a practice.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased due to some clients extending payment terms from 60 to 90 days and delaying payments, but management is confident of collection and has made provisions.
items.quote: Some pressure of the you know client ends where and then some of the clients actually change their terms also. So from 60 days to 90 days and some of the clients have been delaying their payments but these are long standing clients so we know that it is not a risk.

items.statement: Customer collections surged 67% to INR682 crores in Q2 FY27; H1 FY27 cumulative collections reached INR1,233 crores.
items.quote: We also witnessed a 67% surge in customer collection to INR682 crores. This highlights our intense focus on cash flow efficiency and operational rigor.

items.statement: Mature projects generate strong operating cash flows reinvested into new projects; new JDA projects are cash flow negative for first 2 years then turn positive from year 3.
items.quote: You will see that our existing mature projects continue to deliver strong operating cash flows, which is being reinvested into recently launched and new yet to be launched projects.

items.statement: Management estimates reaching steady state cash flows within 2 years as 8-10 non-Thane projects mature and Thane remains net cash positive.
items.quote: So, between these two, I think within -- I mean, my estimate is that within a period of 2 years, we will reach that steady state and you will start seeing much more stability in cash flows.

items.statement: Subsidiary raised INR210 crores from ICICI Prudential AMC AIF via OCPRS representing 60% of project peak investment; promoter committing INR400 crores equity with first tranche coming shortly.
items.quote: We are also very happy to share that Raymond Realty's subsidiary company has raised INR210 crores from AIF, which is promoted by ICICI Prudential AMC Limited.

items.statement: Promoter equity infusion of approximately INR410 crores approved by shareholders in AGM to fund growth while maintaining debt discipline.
items.quote: So, promoter has infused equity of approximately INR410 crores. See, our ambition is to grow even faster and better than what we are and we are doing it with a lot of discipline and the right kind of assets.

items.statement: Long-range plan estimates additional INR500-600 crores equity may be needed over next 5 years beyond current raises.
items.quote: Maybe in the range of INR500 crores, INR600 crores of equity going forward, we may need, apart from what we have already raised.

items.statement: Management expects positive operating cash flow for FY27 after negative OCF last year
items.quote: This year, definitely we will be seeing a positive cash flow.

items.statement: Receivables increased due to higher turnover; 80% of prior season collections received by Oct-Nov
items.quote: The receivables for whatever happened for the previous season, by October-November, we have received 80% of the payments.

items.statement: Acquiring Hara Communications for Rs 10-15 crore via share swap and bank loan
items.quote: Around like 10 crores to 15 crores.

items.statement: Hara Communications acquisition at asset value; land and software key assets
items.quote: They are selling the whole company at the value of the asset only. So, asset value is itself more than 10 crores.

items.statement: Hara Communications consolidation expected by December after share swap
items.quote: Mostly by the end of November and with that whole share swap and everything should be happened. I think by December it should be reflecting in our balance sheets.

items.statement: Positive free cash flow after capex of approximately ₹13 crores in H1 FY27
items.quote: We generated positive free cash flow after capital expenditure of approximately ₹13 crores in H1 FY27, while continuing to invest in manufacturing infrastructure.

items.statement: Collections increased to Rs 5,754 million in Q1 FY27 from Rs 4,993 million in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Collections were also up from Rs. 4,993 million in quarter one of last year to around Rs. 5,754 million in this particular quarter.

items.statement: Total collectibles from sold area stand at approximately Rs 36,000 million
items.quote: And against that, we have a collection done already so far, which is roughly Rs. 114,280 million. So, this leaves us with a close to Rs. 36,000 million of collectibles from the sold area.

items.statement: Loans from related parties amount to Rs 365 crores and are not eliminated due to consolidation
items.quote: Now, out of Rs. 2,700 crores that you get to see there, around Rs. 365 crores is on account of loans from the related parties. They are from various group companies which are not getting knocked off due to consolidation

items.statement: Collections of INR400 crores expected at end of Q2 were received in October instead, impacting cash flow and debt levels
items.quote: collections of around INR400 crores we had expected to receive at the end of Q2, were received in October instead. Therefore, you might be seeing that being reflected in the cash flow as well as in debt

items.statement: Board approved preferential issue of equity and warrants for ~INR100 crore; funds expected by 6 November 2026
items.quote: we are successfully raising approximately INR100 crores through a preferential issue, further strengthening our capital base and providing additional headroom to support a future loan book expansion.

items.statement: Preferential issue funds to be received by 6 November 2026; NSE and BSE principal approval obtained; investors already putting money in escrow
items.quote: The funds are going to come in the third quarter. And this 24.69% is without taking into consider that INR100 crores. So, when the fund will mobilize, which has been expected by 6th of November, we got the principal approval from NSE, BSE.

items.statement: DSO improved from 128 to 122 days; target below 90 days by end of FY27
items.quote: if you look at it, we have just bettered our number of days by six because when we started the year, it was 128 days. Now, our DSO is like 122 days.

items.statement: Management confident DSO will fall below 90 days by end of FY27
items.quote: But you can take it from me that from 122 days, this will get better to 90 days by the time we end FY27.

items.statement: Cash flow from operations sufficient to cover organic capex excluding acquisitions
items.quote: Yes, the understanding is correct. If you look at it, so this quarter, we have done a capex of INR213 crores as compared to INR201 crores last year H1.

items.statement: IPO funds being used for capital expansion including machinery purchase and capacity increase at Pithampur and Dewas plants
items.quote: A significant portion of the funds raised through the IPO is intended for capital expansion.

items.statement: Working capital cycle currently 248-249 days, expected to improve to 200-230 days as domestic OEM business grows
items.quote: Our current working capital cycle, including inventory, is approximately 248-249 days.
